register.formality: "tu" (informal), the register Atlassian and GitHub Italian UIs use. Buttons are infinitives (Salva is accepted as imperative: Salva, Elimina).
register.note: Sentence case. Apostrophes are typographic (’). A sentence-final ellipsis is "…".
